instruction:
You are tasked with designing a Verilog module that will perform a 4x4 matrix transpose. The module should have two AXI bus interfaces: one slave and one master. The slave interface should receive a 256-bit data stream, representing a 4x4 matrix in row-major order. The master interface should output the same 256-bit data stream, but with the matrix transposed (i.e. in column-major order). The module should operate in real-time, meaning that it should output the transposed matrix as soon as it receives the entire input matrix. You may assume that the input matrix will always be correctly formatted and that the output matrix should also be in row-major order.

Your task is to write a Verilog module that accomplishes this task. The module should have two AXI bus interfaces, one for the input stream and one for the output stream. The input stream should be received in 16-bit chunks, and the output stream should be transmitted in 16-bit chunks as well. You may assume that the input matrix will always be 4x4 and that the output matrix should also be 4x4. You may also assume that the input matrix will be received in row-major order and that the output matrix should be transmitted in row-major order.

Your module should be named "transpose_4x4" and should be contained within a single file that is no more than 200 lines of Verilog code.
